description: Read IMPOSSIBREW's published Trustpilot reviews from a daily cached copy of the public profile (4 and 5 star reviews). Use it when someone asks about reviews or ratings, or what customers say about taste, sleep, hangovers or delivery. Filter with about (for example "sleep", "Hazy Pale", "delivery"), stars (4 or 5) or min_stars; page through with page. Returns a summary line, the profile link and the reviews, each with reviewer name and date. Quote reviews word for word.
name: read_reviews
title: Read reviews
